description: Injects a mixed-sign interaction. One condition has a positive individual effect, the other has a negative individual effect, and their combination has a positive interaction effect.
business_question: Which pairs of features behave unexpectedly when considered together? Return the two column names as: column_a, column_b
ds_question: What are the two features whose combination reverses the direction suggested by one individual feature? Return the two column names as: column_a, column_b
